title: Grateful Dead Live at McFarlin Auditorium, SMU on 1969-12-26
source: MSR> CASS> DAT> CDR> EAC> FLAC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a sweet 1969 show with a breathtaking acoustic set, stellar Dark Star and standout tracks like Uncle John’s Band, China>Rider and the rare (Gathering Flowers For) The Master's Bouquet.
ai_review.review: The recording is praised as crisp, silky‑smooth in the lows and crystal clear in the highs – a superb soundboard source that lets the band’s 1969 magic shine through.  Fans highlight an intimate acoustic set, tight vocal harmonies and a powerful electric second half featuring Dark Star, China>Rider and several rare songs.  Overall the performance is regarded as one of the finest late‑’69 shows, captured in near‑perfect condition.

ai_rating.rationale: Over a dozen detailed 4–5 star reviews uniformly praise both the musical performance and the audio fidelity; the few minor criticisms do not outweigh the overwhelming enthusiasm.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Consistently described as crisp, silky‑smooth lows and crystal‑clear highs. Reviewers note it sounds great straight out of the box, with only occasional suggestions to tweak EQ.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: A magical acoustic first set that transitions smoothly into an electric second half via Uncle John’s Band.  Highlights include a flawless China>Rider bridge, a soaring Dark Star and the rare Master’s Bouquet performance.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Praised for his warm Strat tone, inventive ideas, relaxed yet inspired playing throughout both sets.
band_member_comments.Phil: Highlighted for an especially strong bass presence; noted using an Alembic‑modified Gibson EB‑0 with single‑coil pickups.
band_member_comments.Bob: Vocals and harmonies described as spot‑on; banter called “seriously funny” and adds to the show’s charm.
band_member_comments.Keys: Tom Constanten’s B‑3 organ work praised as inspired, trippy, and a key driver of the second‑set energy.
